item.text: {"explanation":"The conditional rule is: eligibility is always present AND enabled; opening records opener and requested focus, while closing restores the recorded opener only if eligible, otherwise the new top request, otherwise fallback. Element changes repair focus only when its current target becomes ineligible. Stale or lower-layer closes do nothing.","mapping":"State maps element IDs to eligibility data, stores stack frames {id,opener,focus}, and stores current focus. Output derives active and inert from stack.","assumptions":"Each call receives the same config for the trace. Unknown nonfallback focus IDs are ineligible. Fallback remains eligible as specified.","applies":"function applies(input){return !!input&&!!input.config&&Array.isArray(input.events)}","holds":"function holds(input,out){if(!applies(input)||!Array.isArray(out)||out.length!==input.events.length)return false;var c=input.config,e={};for(var k in c.elements)e[k]={present:!!c.elements[k].present,enabled:!!c.elements[k].enabled};var f=c.fallback,s=[],x=f,ok=function(id){return id===f||(e[id]&&e[id].present&&e[id].enabled)},r=[];for(var z=0;z<input.events.length;z++){var v=input.events[z],i=v.id;if(v.type==='element'){e[i]={present:!!v.present,enabled:!!v.enabled};if(!ok(x)){x=s.length&&ok(s[s.length-1].focus)?s[s.length-1].focus:f}}else if(v.type==='open'){var q=0;for(var j=0;j<s.length;j++)if(s[j].id===i)q=1;if(!q){s.push({id:i,opener:v.opener,focus:v.focus});x=ok(v.focus)?v.focus:f}}else if((v.type==='close'||v.type==='complete')&&s.length&&s[s.length-1].id===i){var w=s.pop();if(ok(w.opener))x=w.opener;else x=s.length&&ok(s[s.length-1].focus)?s[s.length-1].focus:f}var ids=s.map(function(a){return a.id}),inert=ids.slice(0,-1),got={stack:ids,active:s.length?s[s.length-1].id:null,focus:x,inert:inert};if(JSON.stringify(got)!==JSON.stringify(out[z]))return false;r.push(got)}return true}","program":"function solve(a){var c=a.config,s=a.state,e;if(!s){e={};for(var k in c.elements)e[k]={present:!!c.elements[k].present,enabled:!!c.elements[k].enabled};s={e:e,st:[],f:c.fallback}}else{e=s.e}var v=a.event,id=v.id,ok=function(q){return q===c.fallback||(e[q]&&e[q].present&&e[q].enabled)},j;if(v.type==='element'){e[id]={present:!!v.present,enabled:!!v.enabled};if(!ok(s.f)){j=s.st.length?s.st[s.st.length-1].focus:c.fallback;s.f=ok(j)?j:c.fallback}}else if(v.type==='open'){for(j=0;j<s.st.length&&s.st[j].id!==id;j++);if(j===s.st.length){s.st.push({id:id,opener:v.opener,focus:v.focus});s.f=ok(v.focus)?v.focus:c.fallback}}else stack=[],inert=[];for(j=0;j<s.st.length;j++){stack.push(s.st[j].id);if(j<s.st.length-1)inert.push(s.st[j].id)}return{state:s,output:{stack:stack,active:s.st.length?s.st[s.st.length-1].id:null,focus:s.f,inert:inert}}}"}
